description: This file defines the 'File' class within the PhpSpreadsheet library, specifically for handling OLE container files as PPS (Property Set) objects. It provides methods for initializing the object, appending data, and constructing a new File object with a specified name.

classes.name: File
classes.description: Represents a PPS for an OLE container file, allowing creation, initialization, and data appending operations.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Constructs a new File PPS object with the specified name, setting its type accordingly.

methods.name: init
methods.description: Performs initialization after creating the File object; currently always returns true.

methods.name: append
methods.description: Appends additional data to the PPS's existing data content.
